user.title: BMS Floor Plan
user.description: Add the BMS Floor Plan panel to the Home Assistant sidebar. It installs next to the previous integration, which keeps working; plans are imported from it with a button.

abort.already_configured: BMS Floor Plan is already set up.

init.title: Kiosk settings
init.description: The kiosk is served at /bms-floorplan-kiosk and shows the 3D floor plan only.

data_description.allow_kiosk_exit: A long press in the bottom-right corner opens the full Home Assistant UI under the tablet's account. Leave this off if the tablet is reachable by strangers.
